conversion: Explicit source-parameter mapping; no Xacro expansion or generic URDF converter
actuation: Ideal joint torque motors, gear=1; ctrl in N m. This is not a UR controller/current-loop model.
drive_measurement: qfrc_actuator, subsequently restricted through the declared measurement packet
friction: Viscous joint damping [1,1,1,0.1,0.1,0.1] N m s/rad; zero frictionloss.
velocity_limits_note: For trajectory prechecks; MJCF has no equivalent direct joint velocity clamp.
geometry: Source collision STL meshes and transforms retained; those meshes also provide simple visuals. DAE visuals not converted.
mesh_collision_note: MuJoCo mesh contacts use convex hulls; no external contact task is part of this adaptation probe.

contact_exclusions.engine_reason: Static-parent exception to MuJoCo parent-child collision filtering

inertia: Explicit source inertials; never inferred from meshes. Cylinder approximations remain as documented upstream.
variant_parameters: For ROS scenes use the selected control directory design.json; six-axis backlash is documented in backlash_six_axis.json. This legacy adaptation has no drive armature.
